note: One place at the match: who holds it, what they brought, and what the client shows for them.

fields.name: player
fields.note: Which player holds the place, or a negative number where it stands empty. It has a player identifier's width. In every capture its values equal the seat numbers, because the stand-in players there are numbered the same way, so the values alone do not tell the two apart.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level the seat holder has reached across matches.

fields.name: summoner
fields.note: The spell in one of the seat's summoner slots.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: How the seat is treated. The bits within are undetermined.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The side the seat is on, or zero where it stands empty.

fields.name: botName
fields.note: What the seat is called where nobody holds it. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: botAsset
fields.note: The name the client loads art for it under where nobody holds it, written and padded as above.

fields.name: standing
fields.note: What the seat's standing across matches is called, written and padded as above.

fields.name: botSkin
fields.note: Which look it wears where nobody holds it.

fields.name: botDifficulty
fields.note: How well it plays where nobody holds it.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: Which picture the client shows beside it.

fields.name: allyBadge
fields.note: Which mark the client shows for it to its own side.

fields.name: enemyBadge
fields.note: Which mark the client shows for it to the other.
